Harness: 182 suites, 3426 green, 0 red. Two steps are yours, because the passphrase must be only yours. (1) Put a passphrase of 12+ characters in %USERPROFILE%\.spirit-backup-passphrase and keep a copy somewhere safe: without it no backup opens. (2) Say 'schedule it' and I register the hourly task, or run the one schtasks line in install/backup-windows/README.txt yourself.
